description: Energy Resources - Aggregated PM Data is a dataset listed in City of Mesa open data portal (citydata.mesaaz.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Mesa. Department aggregated list of performance measures and metric tracker. Data reporting may have a 14-day lag. Includes the following performance measures: Accuracy of Switching Orders; 12kV Substation Capacity Available for Use; Response Times to Call Outs; Reliability – Number of Outages; Reliability – Outage Duration (SAIDI); Reliability – Outage Frequency (SAIFI); and Accuracy of Meters. Coverage: Mesa, Arizona. The portal files it under the category Energy Resources. The table has 10 columns. Attribution on the portal: Energy Resources. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-citydata-mesaaz-gov-portal.
